ActiveTask.description:
A long-running unit of work (agent run, engine investigation, monitoring job)
whose lifetime can exceed a single HTTP request or browser connection.
ActiveTask.title: ActiveTask

BoundingBox.description: WGS84 degrees. west > east means the box crosses the antimeridian.
BoundingBox.title: BoundingBox

EngineAgentImageRef.description: Verified Platform image reference retained in the Engine Agent transcript.
EngineAgentImageRef.title: EngineAgentImageRef

EngineAgentSession.description: Conversation state returned by the Engine Agent Interface.
EngineAgentSession.title: EngineAgentSession

EngineEarthObjectGeoJSON.description: Engine-exported GeoJSON limited to verified WGS 84 object geometries.
EngineEarthObjectGeoJSON.title: EngineEarthObjectGeoJSON

EngineEventReceived.description: Unmodified Engine Agent event carried inside the Platform event envelope.
EngineEventReceived.title: EngineEventReceived

EngineInvestigationReport.description: Engine-authored report text linked to an Engine-owned investigation.
EngineInvestigationReport.title: EngineInvestigationReport

EngineObservation.description: Typed source record view; values and provenance remain Engine-owned.
EngineObservation.title: EngineObservation

EvidenceRef.description: Pointer to evidence held by the Engine. The Platform never recomputes or edits it.
EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef

GeoReference.description:
Best-known placement of an image on Earth when it is known (e.g. an Earth capture or a
GeoTIFF). Absent for ordinary photos; locating those is an investigation, not metadata.
GeoReference.title: GeoReference

InvestigationContext.description: The working focus of a session. References only; evidence lives in the Engine.
InvestigationContext.title: InvestigationContext

PanelContribution.description:
Declares a UI panel; its component is exported by the plugin's ``frontend_entry`` module
under ``component``.
PanelContribution.title: PanelContribution

PreparedVisionPayload.description: Provider-neutral binary and metadata payload, not a provider request format.
PreparedVisionPayload.title: PreparedVisionPayload

ProjectInvestigationRef.description: A reference to an Engine-owned investigation as observed in a linked session.
ProjectInvestigationRef.title: ProjectInvestigationRef
